name: Dr. Hennry Williams
bio: Dr. Hennry Williams is a board-certified psychiatrist specializing in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT). With over 12 years of experience, he has helped thousands of patients overcome anxiety disorders and depression through personalized evidence-based approaches.
education: MD in Psychiatry from Harvard Medical School
achievements: Excellence in Mental Health Research Award 2022
Keynote speaker at Global Mental Health Summit

name: Dr. Jenni Parker
bio: Dr. Jenni Parker focuses on mood disorders and holistic psychiatric care. She believes in treating the whole person, integrating mindfulness and lifestyle changes alongside traditional psychiatric treatments.
achievements: Top Rated Psychiatrist in New York 2023
Member of the American Psychiatric Association

name: Dr. Morco Davis
bio: Dr. Morco Davis is a renowned expert in Trauma and PTSD. His research on neuroplasticity and recovery has shaped modern approaches to trauma therapy. He provides a safe, supportive environment for healing.
education: PhD in Clinical Psychology from Yale University
achievements: Global Humanitarian Award for Trauma Support

name: Dr. Sarah Chen
bio: Dr. Sarah Chen integrates mindfulness practices into her psychiatric care. She specializes in helping high-performing professionals manage stress and prevent burnout through meditative techniques and cognitive restructuring.
education: MD in Psychiatry from Columbia University
